description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests the verbose output of Git commands over HTTP, including repository initialization and error condition testing.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that might fail without failing the entire test suite.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
